en.title: Renet Returns: Turtles Face Future Collapse in New IDW Comic Series
en.summary: The Heroes in a Half Shell are hurtling into a dystopian future where time itself is fractured. IDW Publishing's latest limited series, **Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tear in Time**, sees the iconic quartet battling not just villains, but the very fabric of their own timeline.
en.body:
Just when you thought the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles had navigated every possible threat across dimensions and timelines, IDW Publishing is ready to drop a new, mind-bending adventure. **Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tear in Time** is set to plunge our favorite mutated brothers into a future teetering on the brink of collapse, proving that even pizza breaks can't outrun destiny.

This exciting new limited series is deeply rooted in the continuity of Paramount+'s 2024 animated series, **Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles**. While the Turtles are no strangers to temporal shenanigans, this isn't just a joyride through history. The official solicitation reveals a dire future: by the year 2037, the world has fallen under the iron fist of the Triceratons. To combat this grim reality and save their older selves from destruction, the Turtles are called upon by none other than **Renet**, the beloved Timestress. First introduced in the original Mirage comics era, Renet is a formidable time-traveling sorceress, wielding the mystical Time Scepter. Her return is a direct nod to the franchise's rich comic book history, which began with **Kevin Eastman** and **Peter Laird** in 1984 and has since spawned countless adaptations across media.

## A Future Under Siege

The premise of **Tear in Time** promises a desperate struggle against overwhelming odds. The Turtles, usually the ones protecting their present, must now travel to a future where they are no longer teenagers but adults facing an alien empire. The Triceratons, known for their imposing presence and militaristic nature, represent a significant threat, especially when they control the future. Renet's role as the catalyst for this mission highlights her importance as a guardian of the timeline, and her partnership with the Turtles is always a fan-favorite element. This storyline also draws from deeper lore, referencing potential future conflicts and character evolutions, such as the complex history involving characters like Ch'rell and the introduction of unique mutant children.

## The Legacy Continues

For the dedicated TMNT fanbase, this series is more than just another story; it's a celebration of the franchise's enduring legacy, especially as it ties into the 40th anniversary of the original comic. IDW has consistently delivered compelling narratives that respect the Turtles' past while forging new paths. The return of **Renet** is particularly significant, bridging the gap between classic comic eras and the current animated universe. Fans have long cherished her character and her unique abilities, making her a welcome presence in any new TMNT adventure. This limited series offers a chance to see familiar characters in unfamiliar, high-stakes situations, exploring the consequences of their actions and the potential futures they might create or avert.

## What's Next

**Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tear in Time** is slated for release on December 12, 2026, continuing IDW Publishing's robust engagement with the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles franchise. Fans can anticipate a thrilling exploration of time, destiny, and the unwavering bond of brotherhood.

content_raw: Just when fans thought the Turtles have seen it all: alien warlords, mutant rivals, an entire multiverse of alternate shells, IDW Publishing has found yet another tubular timeline worth exploring. The publisher gave us exclusive information on its newest limited series, Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tear in Time, set in the world of Paramount+ ’s 2024 animated series Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles . And this time, the Heroes in a Half Shell aren’t just facing down a single villain, they’re up against the collapse of their own future. For anyone who’s somehow avoided this franchise since 1984, the TMNT consist of four brothers (Leonardo, Michelangelo, Donatello, and Raphael) mutated by ooze into humanoid turtles, trained in ninjutsu by their similarly mutated rat sensei, Splinter. Living in the sewers of New York City, they battle everything from the Foot Clan to alien empires, sneaking in pizza breaks here and there while also navigating typical teenage troubles.  Created by Kevin Eastman and Peter Laird, the franchise began as a comic book series before exploding into cartoons, movies, toys, and, most recently, the Mutant Mayhem film universe . Now, the Tear in Time is adding another chapter to that legacy, and it’s a wild one. Per the official solicitation, “The Turtles are traveling through time, and this time it isn’t all fun and video games. In the far-off and totally not far-out future of 2037, the world is under Triceraton control! Everyone’s favorite Timestress, Renent, recruits the Turtles to the future to save their slightly older, no-longer teenage friends from Triceraton destruction!” Renet Tilley is a time-traveling sorceress, first introduced back in the Turtles’ 1984-2014 Mirage comics era. Armed with the mystical Time Scepter (or, depending on the continuity, borrowed cosmic tools she’s not always supposed to have), Renet has a habit of popping into the Turtles’ lives at the worst yet most narratively convenient moments.  The Triceratons are a warmongering species of anthropomorphic, triceratops-esque aliens. Interestingly, they predate the Turtles themselves , created by Eastman and Laird originally for the Mirage Studio’s Fugitoid comic series. Their rivalry with the Turtles has carried through decades of comics, cartoons, and video games, making them one of the franchises’ most enduring threats.  Now, with Renet and the Triceratons set to collide with the Turtles once more, it’s up to writer Andrew Joustra and artist Louie Joyce to bring the story to life, a task that Joustra doesn’t take lightly.  “ Tear in Time is the largest scale story I’ve written for TMNT to date,” Joustra says. “It brings together characters and storylines from Mutant Mayhem, the Tales animated series, and our previous comic arcs in a big way.”  Joustra also teased just how central Renet will be to the story’s stakes. “Longtime fans may be excited to see Renet journey to our timeline, and newer fans
